name: Persuasion
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Persuasion was written by Jane Austen, first published in 1817.
Anne Elliot reunites with the naval captain she was persuaded to reject years earlier -- Austen's last completed novel, quieter and more reflective than her earlier work.
Discussion prompt: Second Chances is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
